description: Canonical SQL migration order for GPUVietnam. Each 'migration' entry is applied exactly once by scripts/run-migrations.mjs and recorded in public.schema_migrations. 'seed' entries are optional sample data (dev/staging, --include-seeds). 'operational' entries are one-shot admin/storage-bucket scripts applied manually. 'historical' entries are superseded or duplicated files retained for audit history — the runner NEVER applies them. Existing files are referenced by their current paths; no SQL file has been merged or rewritten.

applied_order.description: Bootstrap: public.schema_migrations tracking table + RLS
Base auth profile: public.users, public.otp_verifications, RLS policies
users.role column + idx_users_role (legacy-DB safety; schema.sql already declares role)
users.updated_at column (legacy-DB safety; schema.sql already declares updated_at)
Drop on_auth_user_created trigger so /api/register owns public.users insert
public.subscriptions table (plan billing + entitlement CAS target for SCB 3.4B W5)
users.wallet_balance / ssd_plan_gb / backup_plan_gb + public.storage_upgrades (wallet_balance is the SCB 3.4B W3 debit target)
public.user_settings + public.wallet_transactions tables + users.full_name (wallet_transactions is the SCB 3.4B W4 ledger insert target)
wallet_transactions deposit-status columns + pending-deposit index
public.gpu_pricing_config singleton + updated_at trigger
public.models (checkpoint / LoRA) + RLS
public.workflows + RLS
public.storage_files (SSD / backup) + RLS
public.storage_pricing + indexes
public.notifications + indexes + RLS
public.plan_renew_requests + indexes + RLS
public.support_sessions + indexes + RLS
public.admin_machine_logs + indexes
public.backup_logs + index + RLS
public.machines projection table + indexes (machine is a disposable projection of gpu_sessions)
public.user_plan_inventory + indexes + RLS (SCB 3.4B W6 projection-sync target; referenced by machines_billing_inventory_id_fkey)
public.gpu_sessions — SCB 3.0 Single Source of Truth (machine_id FK to machines)
machines + gpu_sessions billing-projection columns + idx_gpu_sessions_machine (adds machines.billing_inventory_id referenced by 0025 FK)
machines idle-state columns
public.manual_hour_grants + public.hour_grant_logs + RLS (SCB 3.4B W5 entitlement CAS target for grants)

SCB 3.0 canonical migration: gpu_sessions SCB columns + lifecycle CHECK constraints (NOT VALID), settlement retry index, machines.gpu_session_id FK + billing_inventory_id FK to user_plan_inventory, COMMENTs
M5 finalization: pre-check no legacy status rows, narrow gpu_sessions_status_check to (pending,running,closed), VALIDATE all M2 NOT VALID constraints
SCB 3.4B settlement transaction RPC: wallet_transactions.idempotency_key column + partial unique index + public.settle_session_transaction(payload json) SECURITY DEFINER function (W2-W7 atomic)
M13 reconciliation audit tables: public.reconciliation_runs + public.drift_items (drift_items references machines(id) and auth.users(id))
SCB 2.1 Phase 2: public.machine_operations durable repair queue (references machines, gpu_sessions, auth.users)
SCB 2.1 Phase 2.5: machine_operations retry/DLQ/metrics columns + dead_letter state
SCB 2.1 AF v2: machines projection_verified_at/message + projection_verify queue operation
Architecture Freeze v3.2: machines.port nullable, drop DEFAULT 8080, Pending/HostPort COMMENT
Architecture Freeze v3.2: legacy port=8080 → Pending (creating/starting) + enqueue projection_verify (running)
Version marker: public.schema_version single-row table + public.sc_schema_verification readiness view; recomputes scb_3_4b_ready from the catalog
